correctness.rationale: The exact f² coefficient extraction in RESULT.md yields the sparse 4×4 Cartier matrix; the scalar line contributes one stable image dimension iff L=a²+2b≠0 and the complementary alternating 3-block contributes two iff S=b²(1+2a⁵)+4(a⁵+b⁵)≠0. The first Cartier rank is 2+1_{L≠0} on smooth locus bΔ≠0, yielding a-number 2 or 1; Frobenius semilinearity is treated via twists. Over char5, S=(2b²+4)a⁵+b²+4b⁵ is primitive and −B/A not a fifth power because B′A−BA′=3b+4b⁶≠0, proving absolute irreducibility; gradient excludes singularities inside U. Substituting L=0 (b=2a²) gives S=−2a⁴(a+1)(a−2)⁵ and Δ=2a²(a−2)²; after bΔ≠0 only a=−1,b=2 survives, with transverse gradients. Independent symbolic identities and direct small-field ranks corroborate rather than prove geometric assertions.
